fixes.explanation: Capernaum is a town Jesus visits in Luke 4:31, so I see why it came to mind. But Luke 9:10 names a different place: Bethsaida. That's where Jesus withdrew with the apostles. Capernaum shows up so often in Luke, it probably figured it had this one in the bag. Nope!

problems.problem: The closing line is still flat and generic.
